result:
Summary: The HotpotQA paper reports that in the full wiki setting retrieval Hits@10 test set performance is 55.88%. This indicates that the gold paragraphs are not consistently among the top retrieved documents, which impacts the QA model's ability to answer questions as it relies on these retrieved paragraphs for context. The performance in the full wiki setting is substantially lower, which poses a challenge to existing techniques on retrieval-based question answering.
